title: Export selected dynamic purchase-order report page to Excel
description: User scene: download exactly the selected, authorized purchase-order report page as xlsx in the chosen column order. Reuse ERP-125 scoped preview and existing ExcelExporter; revalidate current user, purchase-order menu, filters, field allowlist and 100-row cap on every export. Preserve original currency and supplier/order identifiers, keep formula-leading text literal, and make no settlement claim. Existing HTTP audit records the read-only download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify workbook tests plus safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint reuses the authorized bounded purchase-order preview and selected fields, rechecks current-user menu permission and rejects invalid requests before sending bytes.
Workbook uses existing ExcelExporter for only the current page, preserving supplier/order identifiers and original currency while escaping formula-leading text.
Designer offers download and visible empty/authorization errors; unit tests inspect selected columns, row cap, formula safety and permission; document export limits.
